## Checklist

- [ ] Branched off the latest `master` (game ids and `HA_FW_VERSION` are append-only — a
      stale base collides).
- [ ] Rebuilt the web bundle (`node web/build.mjs`) and committed `web/dist/`.
- [ ] Headless tests pass (`bash sim/test/all.sh`).
- [ ] Web client stays ES5 (no `const`/`let`/arrow/template literals).
- [ ] C formatted with `ufbt format`.

### If this adds or changes a game

- [ ] Next free `HA_GAME_*` id, and `HA_FW_VERSION` bumped — **identical** in both
      `esp32/.../ha_proto.h` and `flipper/.../ha_proto.h`.
- [ ] Engine wired into every seam in `ha_games.h` (reset, clear-on-switch, tick, intent
      dispatch, state member, per-player push, `gameName`, and `checkStart`/`loadItem`).
- [ ] Phone client registered in `web/build.mjs`, `web/core/app.js`, `web/src/index.html`,
      `web/core/style.css`, and user-facing strings added to the `en` catalog in
      `web/core/i18n.js` (`t("key")` / `data-i18n` — `pr-check` fails on a missing key).
- [ ] Flipper UI wired in `scenes/hotspot_arcade_scene_game_select.c` and
      `scenes/hotspot_arcade_scene_lobby.c`.
- [ ] Simulator updated (`sim/web/flipper.js` `GAMES`, plus `PACK_DIRS` if it has packs).
- [ ] A `sim/test/<game>.mjs`, added to `sim/test/all.sh`, covering the main flow and any
      hidden-information rule.
- [ ] Docs: `README.md` count/gallery, `CHANGELOG.md` (`[Unreleased]`),
      `flipper/hotspot-arcade/catalog/DESCRIPTION.md`, and a `docs/PROTOCOL.md` section.
